_comment_F6: Added by the F6 foundation owner 2026-10-15 (CR-HouseholdCarousel-2): NOT applied to migration/parity-exemptions.json. Capture artifacts only; the mock-data differences were fixed in the shared mocks.

ignoreSubtrees.reason: The loading and offline states were captured via Locality_Details (states.json `via`), so on TST the app start had finished and the user-info cache was filled: HouseholdDetails_Block's OnReady passed GetUserInformation_Wrapper (mvc.js:2700-2710), set the skeleton household ('Example & Example', About/Photos tags appended after OnReady, mvc.js:2216-2240) and started GetHousehold, which then timed out / failed (0 members, list-error). Parity opens the route by URL under the never-answering / failing mock scenario, so the clone's app-start GetUserInformation is pending or failed and the block waits before OnReady's skeleton, as the original does when opened directly (TST HouseholdDetails loading/offline: 'Household gallery', no tags; that route's parity is 0 for the same block). Every difference inside the four slides' HouseholdDetails_Block (14 structure per slide: 5 skeleton Member_ListItem, 2 TagToggle, Block_Subtitle, AddressSection, SeeMoreSection, Directory_EntityDetailsActions and its margin, hero skeleton; texts 'Example & Example'/'Actions' vs 'Household gallery'/'Photobook'; VisibleAboutTab; bookmark state) follows from that path difference. Masked in DOM and pixel comparison for these two states only; the default state compares the block in full.
